config.script:
childPath="/"+self.props.value
	system.perspective.navigate(page=childPath)
	
	tree=system.util.jsonDecode(self.view.getChild("root").custom.navTree)	
	ancestors=shared.nav.getAncestors(tree, self.props.value )
	for item in ancestors:
		item["path"] = "/" + item["path"]
	system.perspective.sendMessage(
	project=system.util.getProjectName(),
	messageType="updatePath", 
	payload={"breadCrumbPathsFinal":ancestors},
	scope="session")
	#self.position.display=False
	#self.parent.position.display=False
	#self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexContainer_0").getChild("Icon").position.display=True
	self.session.custom.nav.breadcrumb = ancestors

transforms.code:
tree = system.util.jsonDecode(value)
    parentPath = self.view.getChild("root").custom.parentPath
    children = shared.nav.getChildren(tree, parentPath)
    if not children:
    	self.view.params.forwardDisplay=False
        return [{ "label": "No screens to navigate to", "value": False}]
    else:
    	self.view.params.forwardDisplay=True		
	return [{"label": c["label"], "value": c["path"]} for c in children]
